title: Hair, isolated, strict front
description: Hair extracted by default (skipped only for a bald or fully covered figure, or the user's opt-out), lifted off the head and shown dead-on.

body.subject: Reference the attached strict-front A-pose character sheet and head extract. Render ONLY the hair of the same character, isolated on a white background, as if lifted off the head and floated in space.
body.action: Exactly the same front-facing angle as the head on the sheet; every strand, braid, accessory or extension visible from the front.
body.camera: STRICT FRONT VIEW: no three-quarter, no profile, no back view.
body.style: Soft alpha-style edges where the hair meets the air, no harsh cut-out; neutral flat lighting; same colour, highlights, shine and accessories as the sheet; sharp strand detail at 2K.
body.constraints: No head, no face, no body, no shoulders.

negatives: no harsh outline or clean silhouette cut
